description: มุน 2026-07-28 (calendar Phase 1): extracted HomeBottomNav into a shared presentational <CalendarMenu/> (Figma 461:3224) with 4 states — default (4 tabs + Mate AI), primary-cta (blue button + Mate AI), saved (✓ button + Mate AI), form (full-width button, NO Mate AI). PRESENTATIONAL: renders the state passed as a prop; goo owns which screen shows which state (enum v0 = bong-infer + feem-count, verified per-screen as built). A1 (ฟีม ก · mascot อยู่ในปุ่ม): the nav mascot (Figma 75x92 at y=9 in a 70-tall Navbar) is CLIPPED so the head sits inside and the bottom 31px is cut. The clip lives on a wrapper AROUND THE MASCOT ONLY (overflow-hidden), NOT the button — the button keeps overflow-visible so the "Mate AI" label tab still pokes out (a blanket overflow-hidden on the button would eat the label; ตู๋ flagged this coupling). Button height stays 70 -> nav ~94px -> the home nav-clearance (74px, run-page-end.ts) is untouched (verified green after the change). Fixing the mascot EXPOSED a latent bug: the "Mate AI" label was width-constrained by left:50% (no right) to ~37px and wrapped to 2 lines — invisible before because the overflowing mascot painted over it; clipping the mascot revealed it. Fixed with whitespace-nowrap (1 line, poking beyond the button like Figma 102px label) + z-index so the label sits on top of the mascot head (Figma order). A2 (ฟีม ก · no word-cut): the state-2 CTA never truncates — at 320 it fits on one line at text-sm (152<=168 inner); the button also allows wrap (leading-tight + text-wrap:balance) as a safety net, never overflow/ellipsis. run-calendar-menu.ts owns: state-slot (right slot + Mate AI presence per state), mascot-inside (img top not above button top + clip overflow-hidden, with a verify-instrument that forces a poke), label-1-line, nav-height ~94px, no-word-cut via a Range measurement (a flex button clips internally so scrollWidth is blind — Range reports true per-line geometry pre-clip), no-overflow-x @393/360/320. Teeth mut-text-truncate (nowrap + font bump -> a line wider than the button -> no-word-cut rejects) CAUGHT. Figma-fidelity gap logged A2/not-covered: Figma tabs carry an icon above each label; the shipped home nav is text-only — kept text-only to honor done-condition-5 (home unchanged) + not in the A1/A2/A3 freeze; flagged for a ฟีม menu-completion decision. gate_layer=visual/structure. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-calendar-menu.ts#mut-text-truncate
